2317-7084-8227-8345.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
2317-7084-8227-8345.description:
Activate Loot by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Loot ability, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Activate Loot by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Loot ability, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5686-6972-8329--225.easyPrerequisites: The Zombie Cat doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it and has base toughness 2 or greater.
5686-6972-8329--225.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the Zombie Cat.
When the Zombie Cat dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the Zombie Cat enters, Olag and Miau's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Zombie Cat.
Resolve the second trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on either a Zombie or Cat you control.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token
Repeat.
5686-6972-8329--225.notes: You can use either Olag and Miau trigger to put a +1/+1 counter on the Zombie Cat. The other ability can put the counter on any Zombie or Cat you control depending on which trigger is left.

1495-2060-5544-6431-6495.manaNeeded: {B} if Crystalline Crawler does not have a +1/+1 counter on it
1495-2060-5544-6431-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Forsaken Miner.
If able, activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls.
When you commit that crime, Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Forsaken Miner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Forsaken Miner enters the battlefield, Celes's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Triskelion ability from step 3.
Repeat.
1495-2060-5544-6431-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

586-3899-5060-5258-5618.notablePrerequisites: There is a creature card exiled with Cemetery Prowler.
586-3899-5060-5258-5618.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

4050-4153-4186--196.description:
Cast Scurry Oak by paying its mana cost.
When Scurry Oak enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature token dies, Resourceful Defense triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Repeat from step 5.

2866-3338-4096-6696--175.description:
Activate Goblin Welder by tapping it, causing you to sacrifice the artifact with mana value 0 and return Horn of Ramos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Scrap Trawler triggers, returning nothing to your hand.
Activate Horn of Ramos by sacrificing it.
Scrap Trawler triggers, returning the artifact with mana value 0 from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Horn of Ramos ability.
Cast the artifact with mana value 0 by paying {0}.
Mirran Spy triggers, untapping Goblin Welder.
Repeat.

4390-5078-6757-7633-7693.easyPrerequisites:
You control two other untapped artifacts.
Armor Wars' second chapter ability has resolved this turn.
4390-5078-6757-7633-7693.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate Meria's second ability by tapping two artifacts, exiling Sensei's Divining Top with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0} due to Armor Wars.
Ravenous Robots triggers, creating a 1/1 Robot artifact creature token.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Weapons Manufacturing triggers, creating a Munitions token.
Repeat.

1061-7068-7393.easyPrerequisites: You control a Shard that doesn't have summoning sickness.
1061-7068-7393.description:
Activate Niko by paying {2} and tapping it, exiling Timestream Navigator and causing Shards you control to become a copy of Timestream Navigator until the end step.
Activate a Shard by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it from the battlefield onto the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Baboon Spirit by paying {3}{U}, blinking Niko.
When Niko enters, it triggers, creating two Shard tokens.
At the beginning of the next end step, Timestream Navigator is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each turn.

1909-4486-7221.notablePrerequisites: There's an Elf card in your graveyard.
1909-4486-7221.description:
Activate Lys Alana Dignitary by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Cast Wirewood Symbiote by paying {G}.
Activate Mirror Entity by paying {1}, giving creatures you control all creature types and base power and toughness 1/1 until end of turn.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Lys Alana Dignitary.
Repeat.

2266-3430-3755.description:
Activate Phyrexian Ironfoot by tapping it, adding three snow mana of any color.
Activate Phyrexian Ironfoot by paying {1}{S}, untapping it.
Repeat.

3680-5282-7149.description:
Cast Stunt Double by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Stunt Double into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Stunt Double dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Wormfang Newt, gaining its abilities.
When Stunt Double enters, its first ability triggers, exiling it.
When Stunt Double leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Stunt Double from exile to the battlefield. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Repeat from step 2.

3705-4050-4976-6896.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
When Squee dies, Open the Graves triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R} due to Green Goblin.
Repeat.

2173-2459-5220-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Rograkh
When Rograkh dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Rograkh from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Cast Rograkh from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

618-5887-6798.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Werefox Bodyguard.
When the Werefox Bodyguard token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the Werefox Bodyguard token.
When the Werefox Bodyguard token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1256-1270-4785-5477.description:
Activate Jade Mage by paying {2}{G}, creating three 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate the Saprolings by tapping them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

1789-2438-5649-5929.notablePrerequisites: Leyline of Transformation on the battlefield with "Dragon" chosen.
1789-2438-5649-5929.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters the battlefield, Lathliss triggers.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

560-2835-4550-5256.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
560-2835-4550-5256.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Altar of Dementia twice by sacrificing the Zombie and Soldier.
When the Zombie and Soldier die, Fecundity triggers twice, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve both Altar of Dementia abilities.
Repeat.

2061-4377-5913.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Pinnacle Monk
When the Pinnacle Monk token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1479-3478-5361.description:
Play Dimir Aqueduct.
Kodama of the East Tree, Auton Soldier, and Dimir Aqueduct trigger.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Dimir Aqueduct onto the battlefield.
Auton Soldier and Dimir Aqueduct trigger.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Auton Soldier token's trigger, putting Dimir Aqueduct onto the battlefield.
Kodama of the East Tree and Dimir Aqueduct trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

2292-2773-4133.description:
Cast Soul Collector by paying {3}{B}{B}.
When Soul Collector enters the battlefield, Warstorm Surge triggers, causing Soul Collector to deal damage to itself equal to its power.
If an ability from Viscera Seer is waiting to resolve, let it resolve.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Soul Collector.
When Soul Collector dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

586-997-5011-5406.notablePrerequisites: Cavalier of Night exiled by Dinosaur Headdress.
586-997-5011-5406.description:
Activate Dinosaur Headdress' equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to Priest of Gix and causing Priest of Gix to become a copy of Cavalier of Night.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, its second ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

876-2034-2703-4365.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Myr Propagator.
Activate Myr Propagator by paying {3} and tapping it, creating two token copies of itself.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the tapped Myr Propagator and a Myr Propagator token, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Myr Propagator tokens.

1046-1479-2374.notablePrerequisites: You have a basic Forest in hand.
1046-1479-2374.description:
Play a basic Forest card from your hand.
Kodama and Maja trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield from your hand.
Holding priority, activate the basic Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Maja trigger, creating a 1/1 Human Warrior creature token.
When the Human Warrior enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers.
Holding priority, activate Living Twister's second ability by paying {G}, returning the Forest from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting the Forest onto the battlefield from your hand.
When the Forest enters the battlefield, Maja triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

4163-4591-5109.description:
Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
When Volcano Hellion enters the battlefield, it triggers, dealing an arbitrarily large amount of damage to you and Metropolis Reformer.
Metropolis Reformer triggers, causing you to gain life equal to the damage dealt to it.

240-643-2034-3082.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Triumph of Saint Katherine, adding {C}{C}.
Triumph of Saint Katherine dies, triggering itself and Atla Palani.
Resolve the Triumph of Saint Katherine trigger, exiling it and the top six cards of your library into a face-down pile, then shuffling that pile and putting it on top of your library.
Resolve the Atla Palani trigger, revealing cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and putting that card onto the battlefield.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing that creature, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 4 until Triumph of Saint Katherine is on the battlefield again.
Repeat from step 1.

893-1651-3698.description:
Activate Myr Turbine's first ability by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
The Myr enters the battlefield, triggering Grinding Station, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Myr and Grinding Station, untapping Myr Turbine.
Repeat.
